title: Multiplicative derivative
statement: For a function $F$ from the $n$-dimensional binary cube to $ br$, its multiplicative derivative in direction $y$ is the function sending each $x$ to $F(x+y)F(x)$, where addition is coordinatewise modulo $2$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional binary cube
